children: Cantor Fitzgerald initiated coverage of digital asset securitization company Securitize with an overweight rating and a $21.2 price target. According to Odaily, Securitize shares rose 12% yesterday to $14.57, a record high.
Cantor Fitzgerald said tokenization is one of the largest reforms to financial infrastructure in the past century and said the stock’s current valuation is attractive.

title: Cantor Fitzgerald Initiates Securitize With Overweight Rating and $21.2 Price Target
